title: Offshore Accountant / Financial Controller
description:
We're hiring an experienced Accountant / Financial Controller to take ownership of the finance function for an established Australian security, facilities management and franchising group. Reporting directly to the CFO and CEO, you'll lead a small offshore accounts team, keep the books accurate and current, and drive the cash-flow discipline the business runs on.



This is not a basic bookkeeping role. You'll own day-to-day finance, oversee Australian payroll, lead debtor collections, and work directly with the client's leadership and external accountants. It's a long-term, full-time seat for someone who wants real ownership and direct client access.



What You'll Do:

• Maintain accurate, current accounting records in QuickBooks Online across multiple entities

• Prepare weekly cash-flow forecasts and monthly management reports (P&L, balance sheet, debtor and creditor ageing, variance analysis)

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, intercompany and key balance-sheet accounts

• Oversee Australian payroll, ensuring PAYG, superannuation, leave and Fair Work requirements are met

• Lead the Accounts Receivable function with disciplined debtor follow-up and collections

• Supervise the Bookkeeper, AR Officer and Payroll Officer, setting priorities and standards

• Support month-end and year-end close

• Prepare schedules and documentation for BAS, tax and year-end work with external accountants



What We're Looking For:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline

• CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent strongly preferred

• At least 5 years in a senior accounting, finance manager or financial controller role

• Practical knowledge of Australian accounting, payroll, GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation

• Strong hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

• Previous people-management experience leading a finance or accounts team

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets



Nice to Have:

• Experience in security, facilities management, cleaning, franchising or other multi-site service businesses

• Experience working directly with external Australian accountants

• Exposure to shift-work or labour-intensive payroll environments



Work Setup:

• Fully remote

• Schedule: Day shift aligned to Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT), Monday to Friday

• Must have a reliable work-from-home setup



Additional Benefits:

• Service Delivery Incentive (Attendance)



How to Apply:

Fill out our application form:

title: Virtual Assistant – Content & Ad Agency Support
description:
Type: Full-time, remote

Location: Remote – flexible hours

----



Hey guys,

My name's Kasey.  I run a content agency for realtors and small business in the US.



At present, I need some help.

We have people to handle the shooting, video editing, planning, etc.



What I'm missing is someone to act as my personal assistant and organizer.

I need a VA who is:

- detailed oriented, 

-speaks excellent English

-Help ensure my video editors are delivering on time

-Do basic Quality Assurance on video content

-Act as the go-between for me, my team, my clients.



Basically, I'm wasting too much time uploading videos, organizing them, sending them to my team, sending drafts back to clients, and then eventually placing the videos in a social media scheduler post.



The work isn't too intensive or fast paced.  But I need someone reliable who can make sure things end up where they need to be.



I just need someone to take over the more basic tasks so I can focus on making better content and growing the company.

----

Your Core Responsibilities

Upload raw video clips and organize files for the editing team

Review and perform quality control on returned edits (checking pacing, captions, and accuracy)

Coordinate with editors to ensure thumbnails and deliverables are complete

Organize finished videos in Google Drive and prepare them for our scheduling team

Track progress in Trello and communicate updates clearly in Slack

Proactively identify when clients need more content or when a video needs review — and make sure it gets handled

Brainstorm 7-second Reel ideas using existing client B-roll

Occasionally assist with ad campaign coordination (basic Meta Ads understanding required)





----

What We’re Looking For

Highly self-directed and proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do next

Strong written and spoken English

Excellent communication and organizational skills

Familiarity with Trello, Slack, Google Drive, Loom, and Metricool.

Comfortable managing multiple projects and clients at once

Awareness of short-form content trends (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts)

A team player with a positive, problem-solving mindset

---

The Good Stuff about working with me -



Flexible schedule — results matter more than hours

Small, friendly team where initiative is noticed and rewarded

Long-term stability for the right person 



----

To Apply:

title: Real Estate Bookkeeper / Clean Up specialist
description:
General Description:



Our company, 7DayBookkeeper, is looking for a real estate bookkeeper!



The Bookkeeper is responsible for maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of financial transactions by establishing accounts, recording, and posting transactions for our clients.



The Bookkeeper also plays a key role in tracking expenses, managing invoices, and providing insights to support financial decision-making. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of bookkeeping principles and best practices.



Job Responsibilities:

- Full-Time Bookkeeper — responsible for handling 2–3 clients per day.

- Primarily a backend role, but occasional client interaction (e.g., client meetings) may be required.

- Will help with a lot of cleanup for the clients' books.

- Maintain accounts by verifying, allocating, and posting transactions.

- Create profit and loss statements (P&Ls) in QuickBooks.

- Categorize expenses and revenues.

- Balance accounts by reconciling entries.

- Maintain historical records by filing documents.

- Enter customer checks and vendor invoices.

- Pay vendor invoices.

- Run reports for recommended purchases.

- Handle sales tax reports.

- Follow up with past-due customers.

- Enter received products into an accounting program.

- Print packaging slips and invoices.

- Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local legal requirements.



Job Requirements:

- 1+ year of experience in a bookkeeping role.

- High proficiency in English.

- Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret data.

- Attention to detail and focus.

- Strong math skills.

- Ability to maintain confidentiality.

- Proficient computer skills.

- Accurate data entry skills.



Proficiency in the following tools is required:

- QuickBooks Online

- Google Drive/Google Sheets



Perks of Working With Us 

- Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Welcome Bonus during your first month

- Performance-Based Bonuses – the better you do, the more you earn!

 with the subject line 'RE bookkeeper.' The deadline to apply is on Friday.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
We only accept applicants who apply here: 







Executive Assistant



About iSono Health Inc.

iSono Health is a dynamic and rapidly growing early clinical-commercial stage medical device company dedicated to saving lives and transforming care through innovative robotics, AI, and 3D ultrasound technologies. 



At iSono Health, we're pioneering a new era of breast care. We believe every woman deserves access to fast, affordable, and comfortable screenings. That's why we developed ATUSA, the world's first AI-powered platform with a point-of-care, automated 3D ultrasound system.



To succeed here, you need to think like an entrepreneur, act like a leader, and execute with precision. We value individuals who take initiative, embrace challenges, and are excited to wear multiple hats. Creativity, resilience, and a commitment to excellence are essential as we push the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare.



Our work is exciting because it’s meaningful. Together, we’re empowering women to take control of their health by expanding access to potentially lifesaving ultrasound technology. If you’re passionate about making a difference and ready to be part of a nimble, scrappy team that values impact over hierarchy, iSono Health is the place for you.



At iSono Health, success isn’t just about the work—it’s about the mindset. We’re a small but mighty team of dedicated individuals driven by a shared mission: revolutionizing women’s health and making a profound impact for patients and clinicians. With big ambitions and innovative plans, we thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where every team member owns what they build.



Join us in transforming healthcare and be part of a team where every voice matters, every idea counts, and every action contributes to a greater purpose.





About the role: Remote in Pacific Timezone (PT)

The Executive Assistant will provide critical support to our CEO and executive team while also gaining hands-on experience in startup building, product launch and marketing initiatives. This role is perfect for an organized, highly energized, A-player, detail-oriented individual with a passion for health technology and a drive to make a difference in people’s lives and in an organization. You serve as a vital force multiplier for a team accelerating toward next financing round closure and global commercial expansion. Moving beyond mere calendar management, you proactively anticipate organizational needs, safeguarding the CEO's bandwidth as our most critical asset. From investor relations to clinical partnership logistics, you execute across functions with absolute poise and precision.



If you need to be told what to do next, this isn't your role. If you thrive on context-switching, operate with discretion, and take ownership of outcomes, read on.



EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT ASSIGNMENTS:

Provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO and other executives.

Own CEO calendars, manages priorities, scheduling meetings, travel arrangements, and itineraries. Anticipate needs 2–3 steps ahead; resolve problems before they surface.

communication, including phone calls,
s, and correspondence.

Prepare presentations and reports for meetings and executive reviews.

Organize and maintain filing systems (both physical and digital).

Manage office logistics and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

Possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

Demonstrate strong organizational and time management skills.

Maintain a high level of discretion and professionalism across personnel, legal, and financial matters

Prepare materials for meetings, board reviews, and executive presentations



MARKETING, INVESTORS, INTERNAL OPERATIONS AND OTHER ASSIGNMENTS:

Assist the team with developing and implementing marketing campaigns.

Conduct market research and competitor analysis.

Create social media content (posts, graphics, etc.) to promote iSono Health's technology.

Support with content creation for website and marketing materials.

Manage and analyze social media engagement metrics.

Assist with event planning and execution (trade shows, conferences).

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Creative and resourceful with an eagerness to learn.

Proficient in social media platforms and basic graphic design tools (a plus).

Support active fundraising: track investor pipeline, coordinate follow-ups, manage document flow.

Manage data room access, NDA execution, and due diligence document requests.

Coordinate scheduling and logistics for investor meetings, partner calls, and clinical site visits.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 3+ years supporting a C-suite executive, startup or high-growth environment strongly preferred.

Unnervingly organized. You live by systems, not good intentions.

Exceptional written communication — you can refine an investor
 or draft a LinkedIn post without hand-holding.

Strong confidentiality, discretion and high integrity.

Comfortable in the room when it matters: investor calls, partner meetings, board prep.

Proficient with Google Workspace, Microsoft, LinkedIn, Canva or equivalent tools.

Startup-ready: you don't wait for the process you build it.

Discreet, grounded, and unflappable under pressure.

Genuine interest in women's health, healthcare technology, or mission-driven work.

Proactive and positive attitude to work independently and initiate and complete projects.

Medical device or life sciences experience is a meaningful plus.

Strong project management skills is required.



WHO WE ARE

iSono Health is building the future of breast care. Our platform, ATUSA,  is the world's first wearable, AI-powered, automated 3D breast ultrasound system. FDA-cleared, clinically deployed across 14+ sites, and designed to make high-quality breast imaging accessible to every woman, everywhere.



We're a small, high-conviction team. We move fast, make decisions with data, and hold ourselves to a high standard, because the stakes are real. Breast cancer affects 1 in 8 women. Early detection saves lives. That's not a tagline. That's the work.



We're at an inflection point: Series A in process, clinical traction growing, and a product roadmap that extends well beyond one generation. The person in this role will have a front-row seat, and real responsibility, in what comes next.

title: Technical Operations Manager
description:
We're looking for an experienced Technical Operations Manager to lead the team responsible for our internal systems, automation and technical support operations.



This is a leadership-first role. You'll manage a team of technical specialists, improve operational workflows, and ensure the systems that support the business remain reliable, scalable, and efficient. Rather than acting as the primary builder, you'll provide direction, remove roadblocks, improve execution, and help the team consistently deliver high-quality work.



* What We Offer

$2,000–$2,500 USD per month OTE (base salary plus monthly KPI bonus), depending on experience

Exceptional candidates may be considered for higher compensation based on demonstrated leadership experience

Monthly performance bonus tied to agreed business objectives

Fully remote, full-time position



* The Role

As Technical Operations Manager, you'll oversee the day-to-day performance of our IT Team function while helping the business scale through better systems and stronger operational discipline.



You'll lead a team responsible for automation, internal platforms, dashboards, technical support, and business infrastructure. Your focus will be on creating efficient workflows, improving accountability, and ensuring technical projects are delivered on time.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading technical teams, simplifying complex processes, and building systems that support long-term growth.



* Key Responsibilities

- Lead the Technical Operations Team

- Manage and support the IT team

- Set priorities, remove blockers, and maintain high delivery standards

- Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and proactive communication

- Ensure internal requests are handled efficiently and within agreed service levels

- Oversee Business Systems

- Maintain and improve core operational platforms, including:

* Airtable databases

* Workflow automations

* Business dashboards

* Internal support systems

* Data security and user access

* Technical documentation

* Operational infrastructure

* Improve Processes

- Review existing workflows and identify opportunities to simplify operations

- Recommend practical solutions before pursuing custom development

- Standardize processes that improve efficiency and reduce manual work

- Build scalable systems that support business growth

- Drive Technical Delivery

- Coordinate technical initiatives from planning through implementation

- Monitor progress, manage priorities, and keep stakeholders informed

- Ensure projects are completed to a high standard and aligned with business goals



* What We're Looking For

Required Experience:

Proven experience managing a technical, systems, infrastructure, or operations team

Strong background in workflow design and operational process improvement

Experience leading technical specialists without becoming the primary individual contributor

Ability to identify inefficiencies and implement scalable solutions



Technical Skills:

* Required: Airtable, Make, n8n, Supabase (working familiarity)

* AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent

* Strong understanding of data security, permissions, and access management



Preferred:

* Notion Automations



* Personal Qualities

You'll be successful if you:

- Take ownership with minimal supervision

- Communicate issues early and proactively

- Enjoy improving systems and solving operational challenges

- Stay organized while managing multiple priorities

- Work collaboratively across technical and non-technical teams

- Are comfortable supporting businesses within the digital creator economy



What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

* Lead a responsive and accountable technical operations team

* Improve the reliability and scalability of internal systems

* Deliver technical projects on schedule

* Reduce operational bottlenecks through better workflows and documentation

* Maintain strong service standards across internal support and infrastructure

* Drive continuous improvements that enable sustainable business growth



Performance expectations and priorities will be reviewed regularly with the COO.

title: Property Management Accountant
description:
Key Focus Areas



Your primary goal is to ensure the integrity of the firm’s financial data through:



Precise Transaction Recording: Maintaining a steady pulse on all financial activities.

Record Accuracy: Ensuring every entry is backed by clear documentation and support.

Team Collaboration: Working closely with the Controller to meet Business goals.



Weekly Responsibilities:

- Fund Management: Calculate and prepare transfer amounts from trust to operating accounts for the management revenue.

- Banking & Reconciliation: Record and reconcile trust bank transactions, ensuring funds are correctly allocated to owners and management.

- Accounts Payable: Manage the AP process, including invoice review and payment preparation.

- Credit Card Oversight: Monitor credit lines, process payments, and coordinate with cardholders to resolve unsupported transactions.

- System Integrity: Review bills in Xero and manage property setups (commissions, fees, and owner assignments) in Clearing and Hostaway.

- Cross-Functional Support: Coordinate with regional teams and Guest Support to resolve invoice or reservation discrepancies.



Monthly Responsibilities:

- Financial Reporting: Prepare draft owner statements, month-end journal entries for revenue/accruals, and ad-hoc revenue reports.

- Homeowner Invoicing: Create and upload monthly cleaning and maintenance invoices to Clearing software.

- Compliance & Tax: Support Sales Tax tracking and prepare reports for local and municipal tourism tax

- Audit Support: Maintain meticulous schedules and documentation for audits and reviews.

- Process Improvement: Adhere to SOPs and immediately escalate any discrepancies to the Controller.



Requirements:

- Proven experience in accounting for property management business is an asset

- Proficiency in Xero, and property management software (Hostaway/Clearing).

- Strong communication skills to collaborate with North American teams.

- Ability to work the required Eastern Time shift.



Application Instructions:



To apply, please attach your updated resume to your application. In the
 subject line, include the word "PM Accountant" exactly as written.

title: US Payroll & Accounting Operations Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a family-run refrigerated trucking company based in Florida. We operate approximately 19 trucks, six nights per week, hauling seafood and produce along the East Coast.



We are rebuilding our accounting and operations processes using better systems, clear written procedures, and practical automation. We are looking for someone who is accurate, organized, dependable, and interested in growing with the company.



The Role



Your initial responsibility will be taking ownership of our payroll and accounting-operations processes.



This includes:



* Payroll preparation and review

* Driver per diem and cash-advance reconciliation

* Trip-document review

* Vendor-bill entry

* Check preparation

* Accounts-payable support

* Document organization

* QuickBooks entry

* Process documentation and improvement



This is not basic data entry. You will be expected to understand what the documents mean, identify missing information, investigate differences, and maintain clear support for every number entered.



Over time, a strong performer may take on additional billing, accounts-receivable, reconciliation, and financial-reporting responsibilities.



What You Will Own:



1. Payroll



* Learn and document our complete payroll process.

* Prepare and review payroll information for drivers and employees.

* Compare payroll information against dispatch records, trips, and supporting documents.

* Identify missing or inconsistent information before payroll is finalized.

* Maintain payroll records and supporting documentation.

* Track payroll corrections, reimbursements, advances, and exceptions.

* Complete payroll work accurately and according to a fixed schedule.



Direct experience with US payroll is strongly preferred.



2. Driver Trip Bags



Our drivers return physical trip envelopes called **trip bags**. Each trip bag should include receipts, trip logs, fuel information, mileage information, trip numbers, truck numbers, and other supporting documents.



You will:



* Review scanned trip bags for completeness.

* Confirm that required trip logs and receipts are included.

* Match receipts and expenses to the correct driver and trip.

* Identify missing, duplicate, or unsupported expenses.

* Maintain a list of missing documentation.

* Follow up with the Florida team until all required information is received.

* Organize completed trip records in a consistent digital filing system.



Our Florida office will collect and scan the physical paperwork. You will own the review, reconciliation, tracking, and accounting process.



3. Per Diem and Driver Cash Advances



Drivers may receive cash advances through Comdata for:



* Per diem

* Gate fees

* Unloading fees

* Other approved trip expenses



You will:



* Review weekly Comdata reports.

* Match cash advances to the correct trip and driver.

* Compare per diem to the approved payroll table.

* Separate each advance into the proper expense category.

* Properly allocate advances covering two drivers.

* Confirm that non-per-diem expenses have supporting receipts.

* Identify and report unexplained or unsupported amounts.

* Provide a completed breakdown for accounting and trip-cost reporting.



4. QuickBooks and Accounts Payable



* Enter vendor bills into QuickBooks.

* Confirm the vendor, date, amount, expense account, department, and supporting documentation.

* Check for duplicate bills.

* Attach supporting documents when available.

* Maintain accurate vendor records.

* Prepare checks and payment packages for review.

* Track payment status and properly file support after payment.

* Never release or move company funds without US approval.



5. Document and Administrative Support



* Maintain organized payroll, trip, vendor, and accounting files.

* Review scanned hand tickets and bills of lading.

* Confirm that all required documents are included before sending them to billing.

* Send completed digital packets to the appropriate tea
mber.

* Assist with invoices that must be mailed or faxed.

* Provide dispatch sheets and supporting records when requested.

* Retrieve documents quickly when management, customers, or auditors request them.



6. Process Improvement



* Write a clear SOP for every recurring task.

* Create checklists and exception trackers.

* Recommend ways to reduce repetitive manual work.

* Use Excel, Google Sheets, and approved AI tools to improve efficiency.

* Maintain human review over payroll, accounting entries, and payment decisions.

* Never use AI to guess or create accounting numbers.



- Required Qualifications



* At least three years of bookkeeping, payroll, or accounting experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance, or a related field

* Strong QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop experience

* Direct payroll-processing or payroll-review experience

* Accounts-payable and vendor-bill experience

* Strong reconciliation and problem-solving ability

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong attention to detail

* Ability to maintain confidential payroll and employee information

* Ability to work independently and communicate problems clearly

* Reliable computer, internet connection, backup internet, and backup power



- Software Requirements:

Must already be strong in:

* QuickBooks Online

* Excel or Google Sheets

* US payroll processing software

* Google Workspace

Preferred Softwares:

* Paychex Flex

* Comdata or another fuel-card platform

* Motive or another fleet-management system

* Experience working with driver settlements, advances, reimbursements, or per diem





- Preferred Credentials



* Philippine CPA or other accounting credential

* Experience working for a US-based company

* Trucking, freight, logistics, construction, or job-costing experience

* Experience with driver settlements, per diem, cash advances, or expense reports

* Experience with Comdata, Motive, fuel cards, or fleet expenses

* Experience creating written SOPs and process videos

* Experience improving or automating bookkeeping workflows



Work Schedule



* Full-time remote position

* Monday through Friday

* Must have regular overlap with the Florida accounting team

* Exact schedule can be discussed with qualified candidates

* Must be available for video calls and screen-sharing during training



Compensation



* $1,300–$2,000 USD per month depending on experience

* Higher compensation may be available for candidates with strong US payroll, trucking, or CPA experience

* Paid twice monthly through Wise

* 13th-month bonus

* Paid Philippine holidays

* Paid time off after the introductory period

* Performance and compensation review after 90 days

* Company-paid AI and work-related software tools



What Success Looks Like After 60 Days



You should be able to:



* Complete payroll-related work accurately and on schedule.

* Review trip bags and identify missing documentation.

* Reconcile driver per diem and cash advances.

* Correctly enter vendor bills in QuickBooks.

* Prepare complete payment and check packages.

title: Dispatcher/Freight Broker/Logistic
description:
SendaRig Dispatch Group L.L.C.

Logistics Coordinator

Independent Contractor - Full-time|  Remote / Jersey City, NJ

Experience Level: Senior — Dispatch AND Brokerage Experience Required

SendaRig Dispatch Group L.L.C. is a New Jersey-based freight services company built on a simple premise: carriers deserve a partner who works for them, not around them. We manage load sourcing, rate negotiation, dispatch operations, and freight brokerage under our own FMCSA operating authority, with the professionalism and operational discipline carriers and shippers can count on.

The Opportunity

We're hiring one Logistics Coordinator to own the entire freight lifecycle, dispatch and brokerage combined, under one title, one desk, one paycheck built on your own performance.

This is not a narrow, single-lane role. You will operate across the full chain: Carrier ? Dispatcher ? Broker ? Shipper, moving fluidly between both sides of the freight relationship as the day demands.

We are only looking for candidates who are already highly experienced in both Freight Dispatch and Brokerage. If that's you, we think you'll like how this role is built, you won't be stuck relearning fundamentals or proving yourself on one side of the business while sitting out the other. You'll be trusted to run with the whole Operations from day one.

What You'll Own

?      End-to-end dispatch operations: load sourcing, rate negotiation, carrier management, and invoicing

?      Full-cycle brokerage: quoting, booking, and managing freight for shippers under SendaRig's FMCSA broker authority

?      Carrier vetting and onboarding, including authority verification, insurance compliance, and safety review

?      High-stakes rate negotiation on both sides of a transaction, carrier and shipper, protecting company margin without damaging relationships

?      Long-term relationship-building with carriers and shippers alike

?      Daily execution inside DAT One Loadboards (Carrier and Broker), AscendTMS, Google Workspace, and Nextiva

What You Bring

?      Demonstrated, verifiable experience on both the freight dispatching and freight brokerage, not one paired with a passing familiarity with the other. We screen specifically for this distinction, so candidates should be prepared to speak to real, specific transactions on both sides of the business.A demonstrated track record of successful negotiation with carriers and shippers

?      Fluency, not familiarity, with DAT One Loadboards, AscendTMS, and Google Workspace

?      A solid command of FMCSA fundamentals: operating authority, insurance requirements, hours-of-service, and broker regulations under 49 CFR Part 371

?      The composure to run multiple live negotiations at once without losing precision on any of them

How You're Paid

This role earns on two revenue streams at once, dispatch fees and brokerage margin, and because you're doing the work of two specialists, you're paid at meaningfully better rates than either single-specialty position at SendaRig:

Dispatch commission is tiered, the better you negotiate a carrier's dispatch fee into their service agreement, the higher your share on every load from that carrier:

Negotiated Dispatch Fee Charged To Carrier Your Share

Tier 1 8% of carrier gross load value 45%

Tier 2 7% of carrier gross load value 40%

Tier 3 6% of carrier gross load value 35%

Your negotiated tier holds for six months per carrier, then you can push to move them up at the review point. Every successful renegotiation raises your earnings on that carrier going forward.

Brokerage commission is tiered based on your monthly closed and collected load volume, the more you close, the higher your rate that month:

Brokered Loads Closed & Collected / Month Your Share of Gross Profit

Fewer than 8 15%

8 – 14 20 or more 25%

 

Example:

 Put the numbers to work across an actual month. At 25 dispatch loads, roughly what an experienced coordinator managing several carrier relationships can realistically carry, your Tier 1 commission of $77.76 per load adds up to $1,944.

Add 18 brokered loads that month,  achievable number when  you're running with real systems behind you, and at our top 25% tier, each one pays $78.75. That's another $1,417.50.

Combined: $3,361.50 for the month, on standard market-rate freight, calculated the same way every load is calculated: transparently, load by load, with nothing hidden in the math.

This isn't a ceiling. It's what one month looks like for someone who already knows how to work both sides of this business. Push harder, negotiate stronger dispatch fee tiers, or close more brokered freight, and the number moves with you.

 

Where This Goes

A demonstrated six-month track record opens direct paths to advancement: a base salary plus commission structure, a renegotiated commission rate that reflects your performance, or oversight of Operations as SendaRig's brokerage division expands.

You would be joining at a stage where these structures are still being defined, giving you direct influence over how this role, and this division is built forward.

 

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

You won't be one of a dozen dispatchers in a call center queue. You'll be the person who owns freight from the first carrier call to the final shipper invoice, working directly with leadership, with your judgment and your numbers speaking for themselves. If you're genuinely good at both sides of this business and have been waiting for a seat that actually reflects that, this is it.

To Apply

Send the following to 

?      Your resume

?      A summary of your dispatch AND brokerage experience, specifically

?      The platforms you've worked with (DAT, Truckstop, AscendTMS, etc.)

call us directly at (888)

title: Mobile + Web Developer (iOS, Android, Next.js) who codes with Claude every day
description:
# Job Post for onlinejobs.ph



## Job Title



Developer for existing iOS, Android and Next.js apps (Claude-native workflow)



Alternative titles if you want to test which one pulls better:

- Maintenance & Feature Developer: iOS, Android, Next.js. Must work with Claude daily

- Part-time Developer to support several live apps (iOS, Android, Next.js)



---



## Job Description



I have several apps running: iOS, Android and Next.js. They are live, they have users, and they need ongoing support. Bug fixes, updates, new features, keeping dependencies current, the occasional bigger piece of work. I am looking for one developer to take that over with me, part time and project based to start.



**What I actually need**



Someone who thinks for themselves. You will get dropped into codebases you did not write. I will give you the goal and the context, not a list of 40 tickets. You read the code, you figure out the how, you ask when something is genuinely unclear, and you come back with a working result. If you need every detail specified before you can start, this is not the right job for you.



Being able to read and understand someone else's code quickly is the single most important skill here.



**The tools**



I work with Claude and I expect you to as well. Not "I tried ChatGPT once". I mean you actually work this way: you keep a CLAUDE.md in your repos, you know how to give the model the right context, you know when to let it run and when to stop it and write the code yourself. Speed matters here, and the people who get real speed out of these tools are the ones who built a system around them. That is especially true for working in unfamiliar codebases, which is most of what this job is.



**The work**



- Maintaining and extending existing iOS and Android apps

- Maintaining and extending existing Next.js apps

- Bug fixes, app store releases, dependency and SDK updates

- New features on top of code that already exists

- Occasionally a smaller new project



**What you need to have**



- Solid experience with iOS and Android development

- Solid experience with Next.js and React

- A real daily workflow with Claude that you can describe in detail

- Good written English. We will communicate in writing most of the time, so you need to be clear and precise

- You test your own work before you send it to me

- You are comfortable working in code you did not write, including code that is not perfectly documented



**Big plus**



An eye for design. Colors, shapes, spacing, UI and UX. I am not looking for a designer, but I want someone who notices when a screen looks off and fixes it instead of shipping it. If you have that instinct, say so and show me something you made that proves it.



**Hours and pay**



Part time or project based to start, roughly 20 hours per week. Tell me your hourly rate and what hours you can work. I pay on time, every time. If the fit is good, this turns into something long term and steady.



---



## How to apply



I do not want a generic application. Three things, in your reply:



1. **Show me your work.** Links to apps you shipped, GitHub repos, anything real. If you cannot share client work, tell me what you built and what your part in it was. Bonus if you can point to a project where you took over someone else's codebase.



2. **Send me a CLAUDE.md.** From a real project you worked on. This tells me more about how you work than a CV does. If you do not have one, you are probably not the person I am looking for.



3. **Describe a normal working day with Claude.** How do you start a task, how do you feed it context, what do you do when it produces something wrong, where do you stop using it and write the code yourself. Be specific. I want to read about your actual process, not a summary of what these tools can do.



Start your message with the word **BUILD** so I know you read this all the way through.



Applications without these three things get skipped.

We're a premium health & personal care e-commerce operation expanding into Australia. We already run a proven Meta 
/Instagram) funnel in another market. The store runs on Shopify, funnel pages run on Funnelish, pricing is in AUD.



The role

We send you a competitor funnel as a reference. Your job is to rebuild that funnel structure for our product, adapt the copy into Australian English, and implement everything across Funnelish, Shopify and Omnisend. You own the funnel from ad click to post-purchase
.



Responsibilities:



Analyse the competitor funnel we provide and rebuild it 1:1— section order, argument arc, proof placement, CTA rhythm. Follow every CTA on the source through to its real end page before you start. Same skeleton, our product, our offer.

Adapt all funnel copy into Australian English— advertorial, sales page, upsells,
s. DeepL or similar as a base is fine, but the output must be clean and consistent: AU spelling (moisturise,colour), AUD formatting ($59.95), local tone. Argument-for-argument identical to the source — no new claims invented, none of the source's arguments quietly dropped. We review final copy before it goes live.



Build advertorial and long-form sales pages in Funnelish— hand-written HTML/CSS with inline styles, nothing depending on a theme stylesheet. All images referenced by absolute CDN URLs, never relative paths.

Mobile-first, always.80%+ of traffic is on a phone and much of the audience is 45+: large type, high contrast, thumb-sized taps, fast loading.



Wire the commerce in Shopify— products, bundle variants, cart permalinks (/cart/:), and the 1x/2x/3x/5x bundle buy box. We supply ready-to-paste buy-box HTML per product; you place it, fill in the correct variant IDs, and prove every tier reaches a live checkout.



Set up post-purchase upsells and order bumps(we use ReConvert — tell us what you've worked with).

Install and verify tracking on every page you build.We run WeTracked (
) for server-side event tracking into Meta. The pixel script goes on the advertorial, the sales page and the upsell flow, and the events have to actually fire — PageView, InitiateCheckout, Purchase — before the funnel goes live. A page that converts but doesn't report the conversion is broken. You verify in the browser console and in the WeTracked dashboard, not by assuming.



Bulk Shopify edits— prices, compare-at prices, clearing stale payment/footer references from cloned pages.

QA every page on desktop and mobile before handover— every CTA clicked through to a checkout that actually loads, every price checked, screenshots attached.





Requirements:



-Proven experience buildingdirect-response funnels for DTC e-commerce— advertorials, VSL pages, long-form sales pages that ran paid traffic. Not brochure sites.



-Hands-on HTML and CSS.You can open the markup and fix it, not just drag blocks. 

-Experience in any funnel builder (Funnelish, ClickFunnels, Unbounce, GemPages, Shogun) counts; we'll train Funnelish specifically.

-Strong Shopify skills— products, variants, cart permalinks, checkout behaviour, apps.

-Conversion tracking competence— Meta pixel and server-side/CAPI tracking. You can drop a tracking script into a funnel, confirm the events fire, and debug it when they don't. WeTracked specifically is a plus; we'll train it if you know the concepts.

-Reliable async communication and the ability to hit a fixed deadline. Work is briefed in writing through ClickUp; you ask questions early rather than guessing late.





Nice to have"

Not this role



You don't run the ads, you don't set the offer or pricing, and you don't build brand identity from scratch. You're the person who turns a finished brief into a live, working, selling funnel, faster and cleaner than anyone else we could hire.

title: Appointment Setter / Cold Caller — UK B2B (SaaS)
description:
QuorumInsight is a UK software company that tells suppliers what local councils are planning to buy before it's publicly announced. We analyse recordings of 300+ UK council meetings and extract early procurement signals, giving our clients 6–18 months of advance warning over their competitors.





## The role



You'll call warm, pre-qualified lists of UK companies and book demos into the founder's calendar. This is not a generic script-reading job. Every call is anchored to a real, specific piece of intelligence about that prospect's local council — for example: "Cardiff Council discussed retendering their schools cleaning contract three weeks ago — has that reached you yet?" We give you the intelligence; you start the conversation.



Most prospects have never heard of what we do, so your first job on every call is to explain, in one or two sentences, that councils discuss their buying plans in public meetings months before any tender appears — and that we capture it. 



## What you'll do



- Make outbound calls to UK small and mid-sized businesses (facilities management, construction, consulting) during UK business hours

- Open each call with the council-specific signal we provide for that prospect

- Qualify quickly: do they bid for council contracts, do they have a bid manager or business development person, do they already pay for a competing service (Stotles, Tussell, Tracker, BiP — this is our strongest buying signal)

- Book qualified demos into the founder's calendar and confirm attendance with reminder calls/messages

- Log every call and outcome in our CRM (Odoo — we'll train you)

- Call prospects who opened or replied to our
 campaigns but haven't booked yet

- Share weekly feedback: which objections you hear, what wording works, which industries respond best



## Targets



For a 20-hour week, after a two-week ramp:



- 40–60 dials per day worked

- 3–5 qualified appointments booked per week

- 70%+ show rate (you own the confirmations)



A qualified appointment = right type of company, right person, demo actually attended. Bonuses are paid on quality, not calendar volume.



## Requirements



- 2+ years of cold calling or appointment setting for UK, US, or Australian B2B campaigns — you can share your numbers

- Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent — you'll be speaking with British business owners and managers

- Confident explaining something the prospect has never heard of; you enjoy the "wait, that's possible?" reaction

- Available to work UK business hours (approximately 4:00 PM – 12:00 midnight Philippine time; we'll agree a fixed window within that, e.g. 5:00 PM – 9:00 PM PHT to catch the UK morning and lunchtime)

- Reliable setup: quiet home workspace, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet (at least 25 Mbps, with backup), and a computer that can run a browser-based dialler and CRM

- Disciplined with CRM logging and follow-ups; comfortable being measured on outcomes, not hours online



**Bonus points for:** experience selling software subscriptions, data or market intelligence products; any exposure to government or procurement-related campaigns; familiarity with Odoo, Instantly, or VoIP diallers.



## Compensation



Base monthly pay (part-time) + per-qualified-appointment bonus + a percentage of first-year revenue on any deal that closes from your bookings. Paid twice monthly via Wise or your preferred method. Exact figures depend on experience and will be discussed at interview — the structure is designed so a good month clearly beats a flat rate. Consistent performance leads to full-time hours and increased base pay.



## How to apply





1. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and pitching us any product you like (this matters more than your CV)

2. Your cold calling numbers from a previous campaign (dials/day, appointments/week, show rate)

3. One or two lines on your experience calling UK or US markets





Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Walmart Product Sourcing VA / Online Arbitrage Product Researcher
description:
# Walmart Product Sourcing VA — Online Arbitrage / Storefront Stalking



Starting Pay: $5.00/hourHours: 40 hours/weekWork Type: Remote | Full-Time



---



## About the Role



We operate a growing Walmart resale business and are looking for a detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help source profitable products every day.



Your primary responsibility will be to use a sourcing strategy called Storefront Stalking on the Walmart marketplace. You’ll analyze Walmart third-party seller storefronts, identify profitable products, locate suppliers online, and submit qualified buying opportunities for review.



This is a structured, analytical role. Success comes from following a proven process precisely and consistently—not from guessing or improvising. If you enjoy working within established systems and continuously improving, you’ll thrive here.



Every lead you submit will be reviewed. You’ll receive clear feedback explaining what was done correctly, what needs improvement, and why.



---



## How the Position Works



### 3-Day Paid Trial



Your first 3 days are a paid trial.



As long as you follow the SOP and submit quality leads, you’ll be paid for every hour worked—no exceptions.



During the trial, you’ll:



- Follow our SOP



- Submit real product leads



- Receive feedback on your work



If your work meets our standards, you’ll move directly into the full-time position.



We don’t conduct lengthy interviews—your work speaks for itself.



---



## Full-Time Position



Once hired, you’ll work approximately 40 hours per week sourcing profitable products.



You’ll continue receiving feedback on your submissions and will be expected to apply that feedback consistently.



VAs who take feedback seriously and improve over time are the ones who grow the fastest—and the ones we invest in the most.



Repeatedly making the same mistakes after they’ve been explained is the primary reason someone is removed from the role.



---



## Growth Opportunities



Top performers may receive:



- Performance bonuses



- Pay increases



- Promotion into VA management



- Long-term opportunities, such as Sales Manager



If you consistently perform well and continue improving, there is a clear path for growth.



---



## What We Provide



We’ve built this role to make success as straightforward as possible.



You’ll receive:



- A detailed step-by-step SOP



- A dedicated AI assistant trained on our workflows, sourcing criteria, and common questions



- Direct access to your manager whenever needed



- Continuous feedback to help you improve



---



## Responsibilities



You will:



- Browse Walmart third-party seller storefronts



- Analyze products using sourcing software and manual calculations



- Research suppliers through Google Shopping and retailer websites



- Apply coupons and discounts where available



- Simulate checkout to verify final costs



- Submit complete, accurate leads into Google Sheets



- Review feedback and continually improve



---



## Product Requirements



Products generally must meet our sourcing criteria, including minimum requirements for:



- Sales Velocity / Estimated Monthly Sales



- ROI



- Profit



- Competition level



- Buy Box stability



- Walmart presence (competing against Walmart directly)



- IP safety



All specific buying criteria will be covered during training.



---



## Required Information for Every Lead



Each submission must include:



- Product title



- UPC / Item ID



- Walmart listing link



- Supplier link



- Final buy cost



- Selling price used



- Estimated profit



- ROI



- Fulfillment method (WFS / FBM)



- Estimated monthly sales



- Offer count



- Promo codes used



- VA notes



Incomplete submissions will not be reviewed.



---



## Requirements



### Required



- Previous experience with Online Arbitrage (Walmart or Amazon)



- Exceptional attention to detail



- Proficiency with Google Sheets



- Reliable internet connection and personal computer



- Good written English



- Ability to follow detailed processes independently



### Preferred



- Experience with Walmart-specific sourcing tools (e.g., SellerAmp, Keepa equivalents, or tactical arbitrage tools)



- Experience calculating ROI and profit margins



---



## Who This Role Is For



You’ll do well in this role if you’re:



- Patient



- Detail-oriented



- Methodical



- Coachable



- Comfortable following structured, analytical systems



This role is not a good fit if you regularly cut corners, guess, or ignore instructions.



If you enjoy learning, improving, and following proven systems, we’d love to hear from you.



---



## Before You Apply



Please read this entire posting carefully.



Only apply if, when accepted, you’re ready to begin your 3-day paid trial within 24 hours.



To be considered, follow these instructions exactly:

 address.

eting to review performance, discuss ideas, and plan content for the upcoming week.

title: PRO-LEVEL VIDEO EDITOR (World-Class Full Time Video Editor)
description:
READ THIS FIRST. DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT WORLD CLASS



If you are a “good editor”, a “badass editor”, or “still improving”… this is NOT for you.



I am Stefan, founder of Status Alpha, a high ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



I am looking for ONE editor who is so good that:



• You would be hired full time by companies like Alex Hormozi’s

• You are already operating at a pro, high end agency level

• You look at most YouTube or Instagram edits and think “I can do better than that easily”



If that is not you, stop reading.



This is NOT a learning role.

This is NOT a “grow with us” role.

This is a seat for a PRO who already knows how to deliver world class editing and thumbnails and just needs the right brand and volume.



---



WHO WE ARE



• Brand: Status Alpha

• Niche: Men’s performance, physique, natural hormones, self image, energy, business and relationships

• Content style: punchy, fast paced, story driven, high proof, high authority

• Platforms: YouTube long form and Shorts, Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, X



You will be editing:



• Talking head video with B roll VSLs

• Deep training videos

• Gym, lifestyle and vlog content

• Client testimonials

• High impact reels and Shorts



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will OWN the final look and performance of our video content. Not as a “button pusher”, but as the person responsible for making our content compete with the best on the internet.



### 1) World class short form editing Reels, Shorts, TikToks



• Take raw 4K talking head and B roll and turn it into

• Hook driven, high retention vertical videos

• With perfect pacing, snappy cuts, silence removed, and no “dead” frames



• Use

• Kinetic typography and on screen text that actually helps retention, not clutter

• Smart zooms, crops, reframes and push ins that feel intentional

• Pattern interrupts, b roll, 
s and overlays that support the message



• You understand retention graphs, mid roll drops and what keeps people watching in the first three seconds.



### 2) High end long form editing YouTube, trainings, VSLs



• Edit ten to sixty plus minute videos into

• Clean, engaging long form with strong cold opens and no dead air

• Logical chapters

• Seamless transitions and visual variety to keep attention



• Combine

• A roll talking head

• B roll gym, lifestyle, screen shares, social proof

• On screen graphics, lower thirds, callouts, subtle effects



Your long form edits feel like a Netflix documentary or a top tier YouTube channel, not a random Zoom recording.



### 3) Thumbnail creation that DRIVES CLICKS



• Design high performance thumbnails that

• Are readable at a glance on mobile

• Have clear subject separation and strong contrast

• Use composition and text that make people click



• You already study and model

• Top business, fitness and education thumbnails on YouTube

• Data from click through rate and retention



• You know how to

• Choose the perfect frame

• Clean up the subject with light retouching if needed

• Use text two to four words max that hits pain or curiosity



### 4) Sound design and polish



• Clean audio denoise, EQ, compression

• Add music where needed and know when NOT to

• Mix levels so voice, music and effects are perfectly balanced

• Sync sound effects with motion for punch



### 5) Quality control and over delivery



• You never ship a “good enough” edit.

• Every video you touch

• You compare it to the top one to three videos in that topic on YouTube and Instagram

• You ask: “If I saw this in my own feed, would I stop and watch or click”



• You catch

• Typos in on screen text

• Weird cuts, jumpy zooms, bad framing

• Awkward transitions



You are proud enough of your work to put it in your reel next to the biggest channels in the world.



### 6) Collaboration and speed



• You work from clear briefs we have a Content Operating System and clip briefs

• You communicate clearly

• What you need

• What is blocking you

• Where you see opportunities



• You can handle

• Multiple edits in parallel

• Tight deadlines

• Direct feedback without taking it personally



---



REQUIREMENTS NON NEGOTIABLE



• You are a PRO editor. Period.

• You have at least three plus years of full time editing experience for

• YouTube channels

• Serious personal brands

• Agencies or media teams



• You can point to

• Specific videos with one hundred thousand plus views you edited ideally more

• Channels you have worked on that you are not embarrassed to show



• You fully control

• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve at a high level

• After Effects or equivalent for motion graphics and kinetic text

• Photoshop or equivalent for thumbnails



• You understand

• Storytelling setup, tension, payoff

• Hook writing and pattern interrupts

• YouTube and Instagram or TikTok best practices



• Your written English is strong enough to

• Write on screen text without errors

• Improve subtitles when needed

• Suggest better thumbnail text



---



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



• Beginners or “still learning” editors

• People who only cut simple vlogs without B roll or motion

• Wedding editors with no social media experience

• Editors who wait for the client to tell them every tiny detail

• Anyone who is scared of direct, honest feedback and high expectations



---



SCHEDULE AND PAY



• Full time remote

• Forty hours per week we move fast and publish a lot

• Five hundred fifty to seven hundred fifty US dollars per month to start

• Five hundred fifty US dollars in month one

• If speed and quality are at the highest level, we increase after the first month



This is a long term role only. If you are good, you will grow with the brand.



Yes, the starting pay is low for the level I am asking for. I know that.



This is for someone who



• Wants to lock in a long term, stable role

• Believes in the upside of being the main editor for a brand that will blow up

• Is willing to prove their skill and then grow fast with us



---



HOW TO APPLY FOLLOW EXACTLY



 or message with subject line:



**STATUS ALPHA PRO EDITOR [Your First Name]**



In your message, include:



**1) Portfolio non negotiable**



• Three to five links to the BEST videos you have edited YouTube or similar

• For each link, state

• Exactly what you did full edit, only B roll, only color, etc

• Approximate channel size at the time



• Three to five of your BEST thumbnails Imgur or Drive link is fine



**2) Brief background**



• Where you learned editing self taught, agency, film school, etc

• Who you have edited for channels or brands



**3) Tools**



• Which software you use for

• Editing

• Motion graphics

• Thumbnails



**4) Speed**



On average, how long does it take you to



• Edit a ten to fifteen minute YouTube video to a level you are proud of

• Edit a thirty to sixty second reel or short with strong on screen text and B roll

• Design a high end thumbnail



**5) One line honesty test**



Answer honestly in one line each



• “On a scale of 1 to 10, my editing skill compared to top YouTube editors is”

• “On a scale of 1 to 10, my thumbnail skill compared to top YouTube channels is”



**6) Optional big plus**



• A one to two minute Loom explaining

• Why you think you are a fit

• What you would improve if you took over my current YouTube or Instagram content based on what you see online



Applications without a strong portfolio will be ignored.



I am looking for ONE world class editor who wants to own this role, over deliver on every project, and grow with Status Alpha as we scale globally. If that is you, apply exactly as described.

title: Full-Time AI Video Editor for Ads and Social Media Content
description:
# Full-Time AI Video Editor for Ads and Social Media Content



## Summary



We are looking for a **full-time AI video editor** to join our team.



Your main job is to turn our scripts into polished video ads and social media content.



This is a long-term role.



You will be working closely with our marketing and content team.



We will provide:



* Full scripts

* Our founder’s video library

* Voice recordings

* Chart images when needed

* Brand assets

* Clear examples of the style we want

* Feedback to help you improve



You do not need to come up with the full content idea yourself.



Your job is to bring the script to life.



---



## How Our Content Works



For most topics there will be two versions:



* One video ad

* One social media content video



Both videos will normally use the same main story.



The main difference will be the ending and the CTA.



You will not need to create both videos from zero.



Once the first version is completed the second version should be much faster.



You can view some of our scripts here:







---



## Your Responsibilities



Your daily work may include:



* Choosing suitable footage from our video library

* Uploading the footage into HeyGen or other AI video tools

* Applying AI lip sync to match the script

* Editing the complete video

* Adding B-roll to improve the story

* Adding chart images when needed

* Adding captions

* Adding music and sound effects

* Creating strong hooks

* Keeping the video fast and engaging

* Making sure the final video feels natural

* Creating different versions for
 and Instagram

* Making revisions based on feedback

* Organising project files properly

* Delivering videos on schedule



We want someone who understands that good editing is not only about making a video look nice.



The video must hold attention.



It must tell a clear story.



It must make the viewer want to continue watching.



---



## Our Video Library



You will select suitable footage from this library:







This is the voice library to use for voiceovers:







---



## Our Preferred AI Workflow



We have tested several AI video workflows.



Many editors generate an AI image first.



They then turn the image into a video.



After that they apply lip sync.



We found that this can sometimes look unnatural.



Our preferred method is:



1. Select a suitable existing video from our library

2. Upload the original footage into HeyGen or another AI tool

3. Apply lip sync directly to the original footage

4. Edit the final video

5. Add B-roll and other visual elements



This normally gives a more natural result.



Here is a sample and benchmark to follow:







---



## What We Are Looking For



You should have experience with:



* HeyGen

* AI lip sync

* AI video generation

* Video editing

* Short-form video ads

*
 and Instagram content

* Captions

* B-roll selection

* Storytelling

* Music and sound effects

* Basic colour correction

* Creating videos in vertical format



Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects is helpful.



Trading knowledge is helpful but not required.



You must also be:



* Reliable

* Responsive

* Able to follow instructions

* Open to feedback

* Able to meet deadlines

* Willing to learn

* Able to work independently

* Interested in a long-term role



We do not want someone who disappears after receiving a task.



We want someone who communicates clearly and delivers consistently.



---



## Work Arrangement



This is a full-time remote position.



You should be available during agreed working hours.



You must be able to communicate with our team regularly.



The working schedule and monthly salary will be discussed based on your experience and skill level.



Please include your expected monthly salary in your application.



There may be a paid trial project before we confirm the full-time position.



---



## Long-Term Opportunity



We produce regular video ads and social media content.



This is not a one-time project.



We are looking for someone who can become an important part of our team.



When you understand our style you will be given more responsibility.



There will also be opportunities to work on:



* New advertising campaigns

* Educational videos

* Social media content

* AI spokesperson videos

* Webinar promotions

* Brand videos

* Long-form videos



We want someone who is ready to grow with us.



---

- Qualification call: Contact the prospect within 15 minutes whenever possible, determine whether the business is a good fit, gather the information needed for the sales appointment, and confirm the next step.

Required Schedule

- Monday through Friday

- 2:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time

- Approximately 20 hours per week initially

- Approximately 2:00 a.m. to 6:00 a.m. Philippine Time while the United States observes daylight saving time

- Approximately 3:00 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. Philippine Time during U.S. standard time

- Occasional Saturday appointment availability may be offered



This is a consistent overnight Philippine schedule. Apply only if you can work these hours reliably and long term without conflicts from another job or ongoing commitment.



Responsibilities

- Respond quickly to newly interested prospects.

- Conduct concise qualification calls.

- Run discovery and closing appointments by phone or video.

- Understand each contractor's services, market, goals, current marketing, and lead capacity.

- Explain marketing services in clear, practical business language.

- Handle objections professionally and confidently.

- Ask directly for the sale and guide the prospect through payment.

- Follow up until each opportunity reaches a clear outcome.

- Maintain complete notes, tasks, pipeline stages, and follow-up dates in GoHighLevel.

- Review call recordings and improve through coaching.

- Coordinate closely with the SDR and company owner.



Required Qualifications

- Professional English fluency, including advanced speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills.

- Natural, confident phone and video presence with U.S. business owners.

- Previous B2B sales and closing experience.

- Experience conducting discovery, qualification, objection-handling, and closing conversations.

- Experience selling marketing, advertising, websites, SEO, SaaS, lead generation, consulting, or comparable business services.

- Ability to work the required overnight Philippine schedule consistently.

- Reliable computer, professional headset, webcam, high-speed internet connection, backup internet, and private workspace.

- Strong CRM discipline and follow-up habits.

- Comfortable with recorded calls, coaching, and measurable performance standards.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience selling to contractors or home-service businesses.

- Experience selling recurring monthly services.

- Experience speaking with U.S. business owners.

- Experience working overnight U.S. hours from the Philippines.

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel.

Compensation

- Closing commission: 20% of the first monthly service payment successfully collected from each new client.

- Setup-fee bonus: 10% of any setup fee successfully collected.

- Client-retention bonus: 10% of one monthly service payment after the client completes their third successful monthly payment.

- Uncapped commission potential.

Commission and bonuses are calculated on collected agency service revenue. Advertising spend, taxes, refunds, chargebacks, and other pass-through expenses are excluded.

title: Senior Mortgage Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a full-time Senior Mortgage Operations Virtual Assistant to support the front end of the residential loan pipeline.



This role is focused on four key areas: borrower intake, document collection and verification, Floify file management, and pipeline tracking.



The ideal candidate has prior mortgage operations experience, strong attention to detail, clear communication skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



This is not a general admin role. We are looking for someone who understands mortgage documentation, borrower communication, and the importance of keeping loan files organized, accurate, and updated.



Work Schedule

Full-time position

Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time

160 hours per month



Candidates must be able to work during Eastern business hours in real time.



Rate

$8 to $10 per hour, depending on experience and skill level.



Candidates with stronger mortgage operations experience, strong tool familiarity, and proven ability to work independently will be considered at the higher end of the range.



Main Responsibilities

1. Borrower Intake

The VA will help manage the first stage of the borrower process and make sure new leads are handled properly and on time.



Tasks include:

Acknowledge new leads promptly

Make initial borrower contact during business hours

Collect and confirm borrower information

Gather 1003 application details

Open and organize the borrower file

Set up borrower information in Floify

Explain the document process, next steps, and basic timeline to borrowers

Make sure borrower communication is clear, professional, and timely



2. Document Collection and Verification

The VA will be responsible for helping collect borrower documents and checking that files are complete, clear, and properly organized.



Tasks include:



Send initial document request lists to borrowers

Follow up on missing documents

Review uploaded documents for completeness

Check for missing pages, expired documents, unclear scans, or inconsistent information

Flag issues or discrepancies for the team

Make sure required borrower documents are collected and organized

Apply the correct file naming format

Keep documentation clean, accurate, and easy to review



3. Floify File Management

The VA will maintain borrower files inside Floify and make sure each workspace is updated and borrower-ready.



Tasks include:



Create and maintain borrower workspaces in Floify

Build and update document needs lists

Send and update document requests

Monitor document uploads

Update milestones and file status

Keep the borrower portal organized

Make sure all borrower-facing communication inside the system is professional and current

Maintain clean and accurate file records



4. Pipeline Tracking

The VA will help keep the loan pipeline updated so the team can clearly see the status of each active file.



Tasks include:



Update the pipeline board daily

Track each file by stage, next action, and aging

Identify stalled files or delayed borrower responses

Follow up before files become delayed

Provide a clear daily status view of active intake and documentation files

Make sure the team knows what needs attention each day



Required Experience and Skills

The ideal candidate should have:



At least 2 years of experience in mortgage operations, loan processing support, or loan officer support

Experience with U.S. residential lending is strongly preferred

Familiarity with the 1003 application

Understanding of common mortgage documents, including income, asset, credit, and identity documents

Experience reviewing documents for completeness and accuracy

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Strong attention to detail

Ability to follow SOPs and naming conventions

Ability to manage multiple files and deadlines

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Professional borrower communication skills

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment



Tools and Systems

Experience with the following tools is preferred:



Floify

Calyx Point

GoHighLevel

Airtable

Notion

WhatsApp

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office



Floify and Calyx Point experience are strongly preferred. Candidates who do not have direct experience must be able to demonstrate strong mortgage operations knowledge and ability to learn quickly.



Performance Expectations

The VA should be able to support the team by maintaining strong standards in the following areas:



New leads acknowledged within the required response window

Borrower messages handled professionally and on time

Submitted documents reviewed within 24 hours

Files named and organized correctly

Pipeline updated daily

Floify workspace kept clean, current, and borrower-ready

Issues flagged early before they create delays



Assessment Requirement

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a 3-part assessment before final selection.



The assessment will be sent once candidates are shortlisted and must be completed within the given timeframe.



The assessment includes:



Part A: Knowledge Assessment

Written mortgage fundamentals

Estimated completion time: 25 minutes



Part B: Tool Proficiency Assessment

Hands-on / practical tasks

Estimated completion time: 40 minutes



Part C: Scenario & Communication Assessment

Applied borrower situations

Estimated completion time: 25 minutes



Candidates must complete and pass all three parts to move forward in the hiring process.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:



Detail-oriented

Organized

Reliable

Comfortable with deadlines

Proactive in follow-ups

Clear and professional in communication

Experienced in mortgage operations

Able to manage borrower-facing tasks with care

Confident working independently

Careful with compliance boundaries



This role is best suited for a senior VA who has handled mortgage operations or loan processing support before and can help keep borrower intake, document collection, Floify files, and pipeline tracking running smoothly.





How to Apply:

Provide an updated CV together with your cover letter breaking down your relevant experience and skills that fit the role.

description:
AI Ad Creative — UGC Video, AI Animation & Static Ads



We're a creative agency that produces short-form ad creative for

direct-to-consumer brands. We run a high volume of video and static ads

across Meta 
/Instagram) and TikTok for multiple clients, and we

need an AI creative who can take a brief and turn it into finished,

scroll-stopping ads — fast, and across different brand styles.



This is a hands-on production role. You'll work on several brands at once,

so you need to switch gears quickly and keep quality high under deadlines.

If you love AI creative tools and get a kick out of making ads that

actually convert, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit short-form UGC video ads for Meta & TikTok (hooks, captions,

pacing, B-roll, music, sound design)

- Generate AI UGC videos using avatar tools (HeyGen or similar)

- Create AI animation / motion clips for product and explainer ads

(Veo, Kling, Runway)

- Design static picture ads and variations (Nano Banana / Gemini,

Midjourney, Photoshop, Canva)

- Adapt to each client's brand style, voice, and guidelines

- Produce multiple variations of winning ads for testing

- Add AI voiceover (ElevenLabs) and clean, readable captions

- Keep assets organized and labeled per client

- Juggle multiple brands and hit weekly output quotas



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 1+ year editing short-form video (CapCut, Premiere, or After Effects)

- Hands-on with at least a few AI creative tools — any of: HeyGen, Veo,

Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini, ElevenLabs

- A real eye for what makes someone stop scrolling (hooks, pacing, captions)

- Can switch between different brand styles without losing quality

- Fast, reliable, communicates every day

- Follows briefs exactly and asks questions when something's unclear

- Good written English

- A computer that can handle editing + stable internet



BONUS POINTS

- Agency or direct-response / DTC ad experience

- You can design statics AND edit video

- You know Meta Ads specs and what a winning ad looks like

- You can write your own hooks and captions



HOURS & SETUP

- Starts part-time (around 15–20 hrs/week) and grows to full-time as our

client load increases and you prove you're a fit

- This is a grow-into-it role: start small, earn more hours

- 100% remote

- Some overlap with US hours preferred



PAY

- Starting rate TBD — based on experience and hours (we'll discuss it

in the interview)

- Reviewed after 90 days + performance bonuses for ads that win



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully — we ignore copy-paste applications)

1. Change the subject line to: "I make scroll-stopping AI ads"

2. Send your portfolio or 2–3 sample ads (video and/or static)

3. List which AI tools you've actually used and what you made with each
