title: Executive Operations & Systems Assistant
description:
# Executive Operations & Systems Assistant



### Long-Term, Full-Time Role Supporting Multiple Businesses



We are looking for an unusually capable, resourceful, and trustworthy person to become deeply involved in the day-to-day operations of several growing businesses.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position.



You may be organizing
s and schedules one day, building an automation or workflow the next, and then helping us launch a 
 community, document a construction process, research a new software tool, or create a small internal program.



Our businesses operate in very different industries, including:



* Construction, excavation, hauling, and project management

* Business consulting and operational improvement

* Technology, automation, media, and software development

* Personal branding and content creation



Some of these businesses overlap, but each has different customers, terminology, priorities, and operating systems. The right person must be able to move between them without becoming overwhelmed.



## What You May Work On



Your responsibilities may include:



* Managing and organizing executive
 accounts

* Identifying messages that require immediate attention

* Drafting replies and following up on outstanding conversations

* Managing calendars, meetings, deadlines, and reminders

* Organizing files, documents, contacts, and business information

* Creating standard operating procedures, checklists, and workflows

* Turning informal instructions into clear, repeatable systems

* Building automations using tools such as Zapier, Make, ChatGPT, Google Workspace, and similar platforms

* Creating and managing 
 servers, channels, roles, and workflows

* Helping manage social media accounts and content schedules

* Researching topics, tools, vendors, regulations, and business opportunities

* Creating reports, summaries, spreadsheets, presentations, and project documents

* Updating CRM, task-management, or project-management systems

* Writing or modifying small scripts and internal programs

* Using AI tools to improve efficiency and reduce repetitive work

* Coordinating with employees, contractors, clients, vendors, and collaborators

* Tracking open projects and making sure important tasks do not disappear

* Learning how each business operates and helping us improve it



You will not necessarily be expected to know how to do every one of these things on your first day. However, you must be comfortable learning unfamiliar tools, researching solutions, testing ideas, and figuring things out without needing step-by-step instructions for every task.



## Who We Are Looking For



The ideal person is:



* Extremely organized

* Highly trustworthy and discreet

* Comfortable handling confidential business and personal information

* Technically capable and interested in automation

* A strong written communicator

* Able to understand complicated instructions

* Able to turn conversations and rough ideas into organized action plans

* Comfortable asking intelligent questions when necessary

* Proactive rather than constantly waiting for assignments

* Capable of recognizing priorities and potential problems

* Detail-oriented without losing sight of the larger objective

* Calm when several projects are happening at once

* Willing to take ownership of outcomes

* Honest when they do not understand something

* Able to receive direct feedback without becoming defensive

* Interested in building a long-term role rather than completing occasional freelance tasks



We value good judgment more than blind obedience. We need someone who can understand the purpose behind a task, notice when something does not make sense, and suggest a better approach.



## Required Skills



You should have strong experience with several of the following:



* Google Workspace

* Gmail and calendar management

* Google Docs and Google Sheets

* Project-management platforms

* ChatGPT and other AI tools

* Online research

* Process documentation

* SOP and workflow creation

* Social media management

* Written English

* Basic graphic or presentation creation

* Automation platforms

* Basic coding, scripting, or no-code development



You do not need to be an expert in every category. We are primarily looking for someone with strong foundational skills, excellent judgment, and the ability to learn quickly.



## Important Expectations



This role will require a high level of trust.



Over time, the person we hire may have access to sensitive communications, internal business information, financial documents, social media accounts, operational systems, and private schedules.



For that reason, honesty, confidentiality, reliability, and good judgment are non-negotiable.



You must also be comfortable working with business owners who move quickly, think out loud, and regularly develop new ideas. Part of your job will be helping convert those ideas into organized projects, assigned responsibilities, and completed work.



We are not looking for someone who says “yes” to everything and then quietly misses deadlines. We prefer early communication, realistic expectations, and honest progress updates.



## What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this position will gradually become someone who:



* Understands how each business operates

* Knows where important information is located

* Keeps projects and conversations organized

* Identifies tasks before they become emergencies

* Reduces the number of small decisions the owners must personally handle

* Creates systems that make the entire organization more efficient

* Protects the owners’ time and attention

* Helps transform ideas into completed projects

* Becomes a trusted and valuable part of the organization



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the businesses. As your capabilities, responsibilities, and impact increase, there will be opportunities for the role to expand.



## How to Apply



Please do not send a generic application.



Begin your application with the words:



**“Systems create freedom.”**



Then include the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why this unusual role interests you.

2. Examples of the most complicated administrative, technical, or operational work you have handled.

3. A list of the software, automation, AI, coding, and project-management tools you have used.

4. An example of a process, SOP, workflow, or automation you created.

5. A description of a time you were given an unfamiliar task and had to figure it out independently.

6. Your preferred monthly compensation.

7. Your availability and working hours.

8. A link to a short video introduction of approximately two to three minutes.



In your video, explain:



* What makes you different from a typical virtual assistant

* How you approach tasks you have never completed before

* How you manage confidential information

* Why you believe you could become a trusted long-ter
mber of our team



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



## Final Note



We recognize that this job description covers a broad range of responsibilities. We are not looking for someone who has already mastered every possible task.



We are looking for a sharp, dependable, technically curious person who can learn, organize, solve problems, protect confidential information, and steadily become more valuable to the organization.



If you enjoy bringing order to complexity, building systems, learning new technology, and helping ambitious people turn ideas into reality, this may be an excellent position for you.

title: Real Estate Team Admin / Transaction Coordinator
description:
About Us



The Unlock Real Estate Group is a growing real estate team inside Copper Creek Real Estate, one of Oklahoma City's leading independent brokerages. Our agents are in the field every day writing offers, running appointments, and working leads. We need someone behind them who keeps the database clean and the files moving.



This is not a task-rabbit gig. You'll be the operational backbone of the team and you'll work directly with the team leader.



What You'll Do

CRM Management

--Own Follow Up Boss — data entry, lead routing, tagging, smart lists, and list hygiene

--Build and maintain action plans, drip campaigns, and follow-up sequences

--Manage Zillow Flex lead intake and keep statuses current so nothing ages out

--Track lead sources and hold agents accountable to their follow-up activity

--Pull weekly pipeline and activity reports for the team leader



Transaction Coordination

--Manage files from contract to close on Oklahoma transactions

--Build and manage every file in Dotloop — prepare and route OREC contracts, addenda, and disclosures for signature

--Track and calendar every critical date: TRR deadline, financing, appraisal, title commitment, survey, closing

--Coordinate with lenders, title, co-op agents, inspectors, and clients

--Keep agents ahead of deadlines — you chase, they sell

--Maintain broker-compliant files and submit for compliance review



General Team Admin

-Listing setup: MLS input, photo/media coordination, marketing checklists

--Calendar and appointment management for the team leader

--Prepare listing and buyer presentations

--Manage
 inboxes and shared team documents

--Run recurring reports and help build/document team processes



What You Must Have

--Prior transaction coordination experience on Oklahoma real estate transactions — you know OREC forms and Oklahoma timelines without being walked through them

--Dotloop — hands-on experience building loops, managing templates, routing for signature, and submitting files for compliance review

--Follow Up Boss — you've worked inside FUB day to day, not just clicked around in it: smart lists, action plans, lead routing, tagging, and reporting

--Zillow Flex / Zillow Premier Agent (preferred teams) — you understand Flex lead flow, response-time standards, status updates, and how connection and conversion metrics are tracked

--Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable on calls with US clients and vendors

--Ability to work the full 8–5 CST shift, five days a week

--Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, and a power backup plan

--Strong follow-through — you close loops without being reminded

--Comfort with e-signature platforms, Google Workspace, and MLS systems



WHEN APPLYING FOR THIS be sure to put "UNLOCK" in all caps in the subject line.

title: Payroll Officer
description:
Position Overview



We are a progressive, growing mid-tier accounting firm based in Brisbane, Australia. We are currently looking to hire a Payroll Officer in a full-time work-from-home role.



The Payroll Officer is responsible for preparing and supporting the overall management of payroll processing within the Business Solutions Team. This work-from-home role, based in the Philippines, ensures payroll accuracy, compliance with tax and labour laws, and efficient payroll operations for multiple clients.



The role requires extensive payroll experience, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently while proactively supporting team objectives.



As a Payroll Officer, you will provide guidance and support to the team, including reviewing and ensuring the accuracy of payroll processed by other tea
mbers. This role requires a high level of expertise and the ability to mentor intermediate tea
mbers, ensuring that all payroll operations are conducted efficiently and in compliance with relevant Australian regulations.



Additionally, this position demands a commitment to data security, client service excellence, process improvement, and adaptability in a dynamic, remote work environment.





Key Responsibilities





Payroll Processing and Management



• Process end-to-end payroll for multiple Australian clients across multiple states, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.



• Maintain payroll records, including salaries, benefits, tax deductions, and leave entitlements.



• Prepare reconciliations, supporting workpapers, and support submissions where applicable for PAYG, Superannuation, Payroll Tax, and other statutory requirements.



• Support and manage monthly, quarterly, and yearly payroll reconciliations, reports, and audits.



• Support the implementation and improvement of payroll processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.



• Ensure the secure handling and storage of confidential payroll data in compliance with company and legal requirements.



• Maintain proficiency in payroll software and cloud-based systems and assist with troubleshooting basic technical issues in a remote environment.



• Prepare and analyse payroll reports for management and clients, identifying trends, discrepancies, or areas for improvement.



• Generate custom payroll or compliance reports as requested.





Compliance and Regulatory Adherence



• Stay updated with changes in payroll regulations and ensure best practices are followed.



• Ensure compliance with Australian payroll regulations, tax laws, and labour laws.





Collaboration and Teamwork



• Collaborate with internal teams and clients to resolve payroll discrepancies and inquiries.



• Provide feedback, guidance, and collaborate with other payroll specialists and tea
mbers as needed.



• Review and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of payrolls processed by other tea
mbers to ensure accuracy and compliance with payroll regulations. Provide constructive feedback to enhance the quality of payroll processing, supporting a collaborative team structure.



• Cross-Training and Team Support: Engage actively in cross-training activities to maintain and enhance team capabilities. Support and mentor Intermediate tea
mbers to develop their payroll skills and knowledge.



• Planning and Preparation Support: Participate in planning and preparation activities to ensure smooth workflow operations. This includes attending meetings to develop and implement workflow plans that adhere to compliance and payroll-related deadlines, ensuring timely and accurate payroll processing.



• Contribute to the creation and updating of payroll process documentation and training materials for the team.



• Communicate clearly and professionally with clients, colleagues, and management using remote collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, Kudosity).





End of Financial Year (EOFY) Activities



• Prepare Payroll Tax and WorkCover reconciliations and supporting workpapers for clients with multiple locations across multiple Australian states.



• Review workpapers prepared by other tea
mbers to ensure accuracy and compliance.



• Perform end-of-year payroll reconciliations and support clients to complete payroll finalisation steps.



• Support other ad hoc payroll year-end activities.





Client Service & Relationship Management



• Provide exceptional customer service to clients, addressing complex payroll queries and concerns promptly and professionally.



• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, ensuring their payroll needs are met.



• Escalate complex payroll, compliance, or system issues to Payroll Team Leader or external advisors as required. Complete research to support queries.





Continuous Improvement & Innovation



• Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement and automation to enhance payroll accuracy and efficiency.



• Incorporate feedback from audits, client reviews, or internal assessments to enhance payroll processes.



• Maintain business continuity by ensuring payroll operations continue during disruptions (e.g., internet outages, system downtime).





Professional Development



• Maintain current knowledge of changes to Australian legislation and regulations affecting payroll operations.



• Participate in relevant webinars and online training sessions to enhance skills and expand knowledge.



• Maintain Xero Payroll and Advisor certifications, adhering to Xero’s certification requirements.





Qualifications & Experience

• Proven experience as a payroll specialist, with at least 4-5 years of experience in payroll processing.

• Proficiency in payroll software such as Xero Payroll, MYOB, QuickBooks, or similar platforms.

• Strong knowledge of Australian payroll regulations, tax compliance, and labour laws.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

• High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple payroll clients and meet strict deadlines in a remote work environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Diploma or degree in accounting, finance, human resources, or a related field (preferred).

• Experience working with international teams or clients is an advantage.

• Familiarity with cloud-based collaboration tools (e.g., Slack, Teams, Zoom) and secure file transfer protocols.



Personal Attributes

• Self-motivated and able to work independently.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Proactive and solutions-focused mindset.

• Professional, ethical, and committed to maintaining confidentiality.

• Adaptable to different time zones and client needs.

• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.



Working Conditions

• Work from home arrangement based in the Philippines.

• Hours of work to align with international team schedules; flexibility required to meet client and team needs.

• Opportunities for career development and skill enhancement.

• Ability to maintain payroll operations during disruptions (e.g., internet outages, system downtime).



About us:



Damayan is part of the SRJ Walker Wayland group, a progressive accounting and business advisory firm that has been in business for over 30 years in Australia with offices in Brendale and on the beautiful Sunshine Coast. We are a Xero Platinum partner in Australia.



SRJ Walker Wayland assists small and medium enterprises, corporations, partnerships and individuals with audit & assurance, business advice, tax strategies, self-managed superannuation and external CFO services.



We believe in continuing professional growth of the skills of our entire team utilising the best software technology such as Xero and Weel to deliver our services efficiently and effectively. Our accounting firm is fully cloud based and has a total staff of approximately 80 tea
mbers.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer — Full Time, High Volume (Podcast Clips Channel)
description:
We run the clips channel for The Iced Coffee Hour, a finance and interview

podcast. We're hiring one full-time thumbnail designer to own thumbnails

completely.



Be clear-eyed about the volume before you read further: 90 clips a month,

3 thumbnail variants each. That's 270 files a month, roughly 4-5 clips and

12-15 files a day. This is not a side gig you fit around other clients. It

is a full-time job and it will fill your day.



—



WHAT THE WORK ACTUALLY IS



Every clip we publish is already titled and edited before it reaches you.

Your job is one thing: the thumbnail that makes someone click.



For each clip you get a 4K video file and the finished title. You:



- Watch the clip and find your own frames. We do not send you stills.

  Finding the right expression is most of the job.

- Build 3 variants for split testing. The 3 share the subject cutout but

  differ in text, crop, colour and framing — enough that the test teaches

  us something.

- Deliver 1280x720 JPGs plus layered PSDs, within 24 hours of the clip

  landing in your queue.



—



WHAT WE NEED



- You have shipped YouTube thumbnails on real channels. Not spec work,

  not mockups. Live videos we can go look at right now.

- Photoshop. Not Canva-only.

- You can sustain 12-15 files a day without quality dropping in week three.

  Consistency matters more here than any single home run.

- Reliable 24-hour turnaround. This is half the job.

- Internet fast enough to download a 2.5GB file comfortably, and a machine

  that can scrub 4K video.

- Backup plan for brownouts. We're not screening anyone out for where they

  live, we just need to know your plan.



—



WHAT WE DON'T NEED



- Video editing. That's handled.

- Copywriting or titles. Also handled.

- Channel management, uploading, or scheduling.



You do thumbnails. That's the whole role, and we want it done by someone

who takes it seriously enough that we never think about it again.



—



PAY AND TERMS



$1,700 - $2,000/month depending on experience, for up to 90 clips.

Overage above that is paid at $15/clip.



Rate review at 90 days with a clear path to $2,200+ if you hit the bar.



No fixed PTO policy. The work is task-based - if it's done, take the time.



—



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application form below. Takes about 3 minutes.

2. Shortlisted applicants get a PAID test project — $40, one clip,

   3 variants, 24-hour turnaround. Paid within 24 hours of delivery

   whether or not we move forward. We don't ask anyone to work for free.

3. Top 2 do a PAID trial week at full rate on real clips.

4. Offer.



—



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form, not through OnlineJobs messaging:







Put the word NIETZSCHE at the start of your form's final question so we

know you read the whole listing.



The most important question on the form asks for 3 live YouTube videos

where your thumbnail is currently the thumbnail. Applications without

those links don't get read.

title: Data Operations Coordinator
description:
Help Build Australia's Largest Funding Intelligence Database



About Grant'd

Grant'd is Australia's funding intelligence platform, helping businesses, charities, community organisations and researchers discover, manage and secure funding. We're building one of Australia's largest funding databases and are looking for an exceptional Data Operations Coordinator to join our Research & Data team.



Working alongside our Research & Data Manager, you'll help expand our funding coverage from approximately 8,000 funding opportunities to more than 30,000, while ensuring every record meets the highest standards of quality and accuracy.



About the Role

This is a unique opportunity to combine research, AI and data operations. You'll help accelerate the growth of Grant'd's funding database by identifying new funding sources, supporting our AI-powered data collection process and performing quality assurance before information reaches our members.



This role is perfect for someone who enjoys working with data, embraces AI tools and understands that speed is only valuable when combined with accuracy.



Your Key Responsibilities

Research & Data Collection

Working alongside our Research & Data Manager, you will:

Research new government, philanthropic and private funding sources

Identify new grant opportunities across Australia

Locate and maintain source URLs for our automated aggregation platform

Expand Grant'd's funding source coverage

Support ongoing database growth and maintenance



AI & Data Operations

You'll work with our AI-assisted research workflow to:

Support AI-powered grant discovery

Validate AI-generated data

Review and improve AI outputs

Identify missing or inaccurate information

Help improve the quality of our research process over time

Previous experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms will be highly regarded.



Quality Assurance

Accuracy is critical.

Responsibilities include:

Reviewing funding information before publication

Validating eligibility, dates, links and funding amounts

Identifying duplicate or outdated records

Ensuring data consistency across the platform

Maintaining high quality standards at every stage of the process



Database Management

Batch upload approved funding opportunities

Categorise grants correctly

Maintain database accuracy

Support ongoing improvements to our funding taxonomy

Assist with database maintenance and reporting



We're Looking For Someone Who

Has exceptional written English

Is highly organised and detail-oriented

Enjoys research and working with structured data

Is comfortable using AI as part of their daily workflow

Learns new systems quickly

Can work efficiently without compromising quality

Takes pride in producing accurate work

Enjoys continuous improvement



Skills & Experience

Experience in one or more of the following would be highly regarded:

AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar)

Online research

Database management

Airtable

Google Sheets / Excel

Data validation and quality assurance

CRM or database systems

Categorisation or taxonomy management

An understanding of the Australian funding landscape would be an advantage, but is not essential.



Success in This Role

It's measured by how effectively you help us scale while maintaining quality.

By helping improve our AI-assisted workflows and ensuring every funding opportunity published on Grant'd is accurate, relevant and reliable, you'll play a key role in building Australia's most trusted funding intelligence platform.

You'll be joining a small, ambitious Australian technology company building the future of funding intelligence.

Your work will directly improve the quality of information used by thousands of organisations across Australia and help shape one of the country's largest funding databases.

title: Marketing and Admin Coordinator
description:
Why this role exists



Gyrilla Investments Group and Scaling.Club have the content, the brand and the clinical substance. What we need is one person who owns the ATTRACT -> CONVERSION execution end-to-end — someone who grows the audience, keeps the channels alive, runs the campaigns, and connects interested parties with team members to generate booked consults.



This role sits alongside the wider marketing team but carries its own accountability (KPIs). This role is measured on booked consults and the cost of getting there = growth that shows up in the diary.



Core responsibilities

Calendar management

Scheduling — creation, management and updating clinic, clinician and the CEO's calendars (as this impacts the ability to handle)

Audience growth & social media

Multi-channel growth — grow the following toward 20,000 across priority channels, with TikTok for discovery,
 for frequency and LinkedIn / YouTube for trust and longer form content.

Posting cadence — plan, schedule and publish consistent, on-brand content across all active channels.

Platform strategy — use each channel for what it does best; discovery on one, trust-deepening on another.

Community — manage engagement, comments and inbound interest across the digital estate.

Campaigns & sales conversion

Campaign delivery — build and run marketing campaigns end-to-end, from concept to live to reported.

Sales links & funnels — set up, manage and track booking and sales links so every campaign is measurable.

Lead-to-booking — work with the GHL/Lead-Response owner so marketing activity flows cleanly into booked consults.

Reporting — track cost per booked consult and report what is working.

Scaling.Club proposals & contracts

Consulting proposals — draft and prepare consulting proposals for Scaling.Club engagements.

Contracts — prepare and manage the contracts that convert proposals into signed work.

Membership funnels — support the sales journey across the Basecamp, Summit and VCOO levels.



Program Manager backup (during leave)



Beyond its core marketing remit, this role is expected to grow into providing cover for the Program Manager's administrative duties during scheduled leave, so that clinic operations, patient-facing admin and CEO support continue without interruption. This is backup coverage, not a permanent expansion of the role — the Program Manager retains day-to-day ownership of these duties, and this role steps in only during leave periods, with proper handover and cross-training in place beforehand.



Scope of cover



Patient scheduling & communication — calling, scheduling,
ing and texting patients regarding their consults and treatments.

Contracts & agreements — creating and managing contracts, agreements and related documentation.

Calendar management (extended) — calendar management for the CEO, the nurses and select psychiatrists.

Clinical team coordination — organising with the psychiatrist team regarding patients.

Travel bookings — booking flights, hotels, car hire and related travel logistics.

Billing & invoicing — billing, invoicing and creating receipts for patients.

Research — ad hoc research tasks as required.

Operational coordination — coordinating with the whole team to keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

General admin support — any other administrative tasks requested by the CEO.



Readiness for cover



Before this role is expected to activate cover independently, the Program Manager will document processes and provide hands-on shadowing across these tasks, with particular attention to patient data handling, billing accuracy and calendar-critical dependencies (eg clinician availability). Cover is planned around scheduled leave and confirmed with the CEO in advance.



Who this suits

Proven social growth — can point to an audience they have grown, not just managed.

Campaign operator — comfortable owning a campaign end-to-end and reporting on its numbers.

Commercially minded — understands that the job is booked, consulted and signed contracts, not likes.

Professional writer — able to produce clean proposals and contracts (writing is an advantage, not the core of the role).

Compliance-aware — healthcare marketing sits under AHPRA and TGA rules; experience here is an advantage.

Self-directed — keeps the channels alive and the campaigns moving without close supervision.

How success is measured



Success is growth that shows up commercially — more booked consults at a lower cost, a growing audience, and a Scaling.Club sales engine that keeps proposals and contracts moving.



AHPRA and TGA compliance is a standing requirement across all content and campaigns; performance and reach are never pursued at the expense of it.



In Summary



This is an operations and, eventual, automation role. This role owns marketing, audience and the Brain Aid Clinics & Scaling.Club sales engine. This is not a clinical role. The day-to-day operational rhythm and the AI agent swarm are owned by this role.

title: Growth & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Growth & Lead Generation Specialist to help drive consistent, high-quality enquiries and support the growth of a premium design and project-based business.



This is a performance-focused role for someone who understands how to generate qualified leads, optimise digital campaigns and deliver measurable results. The role extends beyond social media management and requires expertise in lead generation, SEO, paid advertising and conversion optimisation.



Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Business Growth

Develop and implement lead generation strategies that deliver qualified enquiries.

Identify opportunities within the dental, medical, childcare, commercial office and hospitality sectors.

Build and optimise lead funnels to improve conversion rates.

Continuously monitor performance and refine strategies based on data and results.

Google Ads & Paid Advertising

Create, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns.

Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.

Improve campaign performance, click-through rates and conversions.

Manage advertising budgets efficiently and provide clear reporting on return on investment.

Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)

Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility.

Optimise website content, service pages and landing pages.

Increase search rankings for target keywords.

Monitor website performance and recommend improvements.

Website & Conversion Optimisation

Create and refine landing pages for key services.

Analyse user behaviour and lead sources.

Recommend website improvements that increase enquiries and conversions.

Implement tracking systems to accurately measure campaign performance.

LinkedIn & Industry Outreach

Develop LinkedIn strategies that strengthen brand positioning and generate opportunities.

Support outreach initiatives with builders, developers, certifiers, consultants and other industry professionals.

Identify strategic partnerships that contribute to business growth.

Reporting & Performance Tracking



Provide monthly reports outlining:



Website traffic and user behaviour

Number of qualified enquiries generated

Cost per lead and conversion rates

SEO rankings and keyword performance

Google Ads performance and return on investment

Recommendations for ongoing improvement

Skills & Experience

Essential

Proven track record in lead generation and business growth.

Strong experience managing and optimising Google Ads campaigns.

Advanced SEO knowledge and implementation experience.

Experience working with service-based businesses.

Strong understanding of website conversion optimisation.

Excellent analytical and reporting skills.

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and deliver measurable results.

Highly Desirable

Experience working with interior design, architecture, construction or other professional service industries.

Experience with WordPress websites.

Proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Search Console and CRM systems.

Demonstrated success generating leads within the commercial or construction sectors.

Success Measures



Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:



Increased volume of qualified enquiries.

Improved Google search rankings.

Higher website conversion rates.

Clear reporting and measurable return on investment.

A consistent and scalable lead generation pipeline.

Position Details

Flexible remote role.

Freelance or part-time arrangement.

Approximately 10–20 hours per week.

Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

Performance-based engagement with significant growth potential.

Application Requirements



Please include:



A brief introduction about yourself and your experience.

Examples of lead generation results you have achieved.

Industries you have worked with.

Google Ads and SEO case studies.

References or testimonials, if available.

Your proposed monthly fee and preferred working arrangement.



0-Day Strategy Proposal



As part of your application, please outline the strategy you would implement during your first 90 days, including:



Your approach to generating qualified leads.

The advertising channels you would prioritise and why.

Your proposed Google Ads and SEO strategy.

How you would improve website conversions.

Key performance indicators (KPIs) you would track.

The results you would realistically expect to achieve within the first three months.

How you would measure return on investment (ROI).



Please be as specific as possible and include examples of similar strategies you have successfully implemented in previous roles.

title: AI & Agent Builder for Second Brain Project (Notion, OneNote)
description:
Do you know what a Second Brain is, do you work with AI every day, and have you built agents? If you had to ask about any of those, this project is not for you.



PROJECT BASED. I primarily work out of OneDrive and OneNote, and I also have Notion. I have years of notes, files and documents scattered across all of it. I need someone experienced to consolidate everything into one proper Second Brain in Notion - and to build it so that AI can actually work with it. This is a short project to get everything set up, and if it goes well we can talk about ongoing work from there.



THE PROJECT

- Audit what I have: OneDrive files and folders, OneNote notebooks, sections and pages, and whatever already exists in Notion

- Design a clean PARA structure (Projects, Areas, Resources, Archives) in Notion, or an equivalent structure you can justify

- Migrate my OneNote notebooks into Notion cleanly - pages, sections, images, attachments and links intact, not a broken copy-paste mess

- D
 with me what belongs in Notion as knowledge and what stays in OneDrive as file storage, then organize OneDrive to match

- Kill duplicates and near-duplicates, archive what is dead, surface what actually matters

- Set a consistent naming convention and apply it across both systems

- Build the Notion side properly: databases, tags, linked relations, dashboards and templates that are genuinely useful, not decorative

- Set up a capture inbox and a simple, repeatable process for filing new material as it comes in

- Use AI to speed the work up: bulk summarizing, tagging, cleaning and reformatting content - with your own eyes on the output, never blind trust

- Make the whole thing AI-ready: structured and clean enough that Claude or ChatGPT can be pointed at it and give useful answers

- Assemble reusable assets from my material: prompt libraries, custom GPTs or Claude Projects, templates, SOPs and checklists

- Set up simple automations so the system keeps itself fed and tidy

- Build agents that work on top of the system - something that can answer questions from my knowledge base, file new material, or run a recurring task without me babysitting it. Build it on whatever platform you are strongest in.

- Write me a short, plain-English guide and a quick walkthrough video so I can maintain it myself afterward



REQUIRED - YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE

- Real experience building or running a Second Brain / PKM system for yourself or a client. Tell us whose it was and how long you ran it.

- Solid understanding of PARA and progressive summarization, or a comparable method you can explain clearly

- Proven hands-on experience migrating content INTO Notion, ideally from OneNote or Evernote. Tell us how you did it and what broke.

- Strong OneDrive, OneNote and Microsoft 365 skills

- Deep, practical Notion skills - databases, relations, rollups, templates

- Genuine daily proficiency with AI, specifically Claude and ChatGPT. You should understand the different model tiers and when to use which, and be able to explain what each is good and bad at.

- Real experience building ON TOP of LLMs - custom GPTs, Claude Projects, knowledge bases the model can search, system prompts and prompt libraries. You do not need to train a model from scratch, but you must understand how these systems are put together and what makes them work or fail.

- Working knowledge of automation - Make, Zapier, n8n, Notion automations or similar - and the judgment to know what is worth automating

- Experience assembling reusable assets: prompt libraries, templates, SOPs, workflows others can pick up and use

- AGENTIC AI: you understand where the world is going with agents and you have actually built and shipped them. The platform does not matter to me - Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, OpenAI Assistants or custom GPTs, n8n, Make, Zapier Agents, LangChain, Relevance AI, whatever you are strongest in. What matters is that you have really built agents: connected them to data sources, defined their actions and triggers, set guardrails, tested them and put them into use. Tell me specifically what you shipped and what it does.

- You can explain in plain English the difference between a chatbot, an automation and a true agent, and when each one is the right answer

- HUGE ADVANTAGE: real proficiency in n8n and Base44. If you can build workflows in n8n and ship apps or tools in Base44, say so clearly and show me what you have built - it will move you to the front of the line.

- Strong written English and good judgment about what matters in a document and what can be archived

- Careful and methodical - a bad migration is worse than no migration



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF

- You have only watched videos about Second Brains but never built one

- You have never actually migrated real content into Notion

- Your AI experience is casually asking ChatGPT questions - that is not what this is

- You have read about agents but have never built and shipped one

- You are not actively using AI in your own work. Everything in this project runs through AI - if AI is not already part of how you work every day, this is not the project for you.

- You are hoping to learn this on the job - I need someone productive from day one

- You are sending a generic copy-paste application



THE INTERVIEW

Be ready to walk me through work you have actually done. Expect to explain:

- How you structured a real system and why you made those choices

- Exactly how you handled a real migration, step by step, and what you did about the things that did not transfer cleanly

- An AI workflow, custom GPT, Claude Project or automation you built - what it does, how you built it, and where it fell short

- An agent you have built on any platform - walk me through how you set it up, what data it uses, what it can and cannot do, and what you learned when it misbehaved

- How you d
 which model or tool to use for a given task

- What the outcome was - what got faster, easier or findable, with real examples and numbers

I will likely ask you to share your screen and give me a tour, so please have something real to show.



INTERVIEW AVAILABILITY

Interviews can only be scheduled in these windows:

- Monday to Friday: 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM Eastern (6:00 AM - 8:00 AM next day, Philippine time)

- Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM Eastern (Saturday 10:00 PM - Sunday 7:00 AM, Philippine time)

- Sunday: 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM Eastern (Monday 3:00 AM - 7:00 AM, Philippine time)

Please only apply if you can make one of these times.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your reply with the word DISTILL so I know you read this, then include:

1. A short description of a Second Brain you built or a real migration you completed, and for whom

2. Your OneDrive, OneNote and Notion experience, honestly rated

3. Your AI experience - which tools, which models, and one specific thing you have built with Claude or ChatGPT

4. Your agentic experience - which platforms you build agents on, what you have shipped, and what it does. Copilot Studio is a plus but any platform counts. If you have never built an agent, please do not apply.

5. Your n8n and Base44 experience, if you have it - what you built and a link or screenshot. This is a big plus.

6. Screenshots or a short screen recording of a real system, agent, prompt library or automation you built (blur anything private)

7. How you would approach the first week of this project

8. Your estimate of how many hours this project would take you

9. Which interview window above works best for you



ONLY PEOPLE WHO MEET THESE QUALIFICATIONS SHOULD APPLY. To be completely clear, you must already have ALL of the following:

- Built or run a real Second Brain / PKM system

- Migrated real content into Notion before

- Strong OneDrive, OneNote and Notion skills

- Daily, hands-on use of AI - Claude and ChatGPT

- Built something on top of LLMs - custom GPTs, Claude Projects, knowledge bases, prompt libraries

- Built and shipped real agents on some platform



NOT required, but a STRONG PLUS that will move you to the front of the line:

- Proficiency in n8n

- Proficiency in Base44



If you are missing any of the required items above, please do not apply. Interest, enthusiasm, related VA experience and a willingness to learn are not enough for this project. Applications that skip the questions above will not be reviewed.
